bugs.title: ST8b class guard false-passes a field whose class token sits 14 lines below the tag (GuestForm's layout), so the tree is green while a faint field remains
steps: From the store root, copy app/ to a scratch dir (c-round-194/trun/m14)
Insert before '<Form method' in routes/hire-us.tsx an '<input' tag with 13 attribute lines and then 'className="border border-outline" />' on the 14th line after the tag
bugs.expected: ST8b turns red ('a new field with the faint border turns red', task T1)
bugs.actual: ST8b stays green (m14). It is also green on the real tree (END-COPY and live) even though GuestForm.tsx:67/:91 carry a bare border-outline on rendered <input> fields. The window is tag + 13 lines (i+14 exclusive), and the guard does not follow class constants. This confirms A's code-reviewer Medium #2.
bugs.fixHint: In the GuestForm re-grant round, widen or replace the scan (a parser that takes the whole tag up to its closing '>' or '/>', and follows same-file class constants) so that it goes red on GuestForm before the fix. Test-only.
bugs.origin: Spec/tooling, not an A deviation: task T1 specified 'the same 14-line window' and b-round-193/tools/fieldscan.mjs has the same i+14-exclusive off-by-one; A implemented it as specified, A's code-reviewer flagged it (Medium #2), C confirmed with m14. B may re-rate.
